title: Nonzero block code from incompatibility
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ Boolean coordinates, let its width be at most $w$, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction. Suppose some Boolean assignment makes every literal of $T$ true while respecting $\rho$. For $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, fix each coordinate that is free under $\rho$ and appears in $T$ to the sign encoded by the corresponding coordinate of $x$. If the resulting restriction is incompatible with $T$, then the block code of these free literal positions, formed using $x$, has at least one position whose bit is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: The term width is at most $w$
Incompatibility after fixing the listed free literal coordinates
